direction: Dedicated wide verdict newspaper substrate. Preserve the approved roadside-kitsch palette and tactile printed-paper world while making this read unmistakably as folded newsprint rather than a county note.

assets.consumer: Win/loss verdict and between-turn incident newspaper behind live HTML mastheads, headlines, event photography, stats, and controls
assets.source_of_direction: User feedback plus the existing cream, teal, raspberry, salmon roadside-kitsch interface
assets.subject: One isolated vintage Florida small-town broadsheet newspaper sheet
assets.composition: Wide landscape, nearly front-on, broad newspaper proportions, slightly irregular corners, generous clean printable center and shallow safe margins
assets.constraints: Native transparent background; newsprint fibers, subtle center fold and horizontal fold, deckled/torn perimeter, light age marks and sparse faded teal/raspberry print-registration accents; no readable words, masthead, logos, paperclip, notebook styling, UI, drop shadow, scenery, or watermark
assets.review: Accepted at 1536 × 1024 with native alpha. Broad front-facing newsprint silhouette, four-panel folds, deckled perimeter, quiet printable center, and sparse faded teal/raspberry registration stripes. Full PNG retained as the artwork master; optimized transparent WebP (375,896 bytes) is wired and visually verified in the live Stage 1 victory verdict and photo-led between-turn incident report.
